newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends slightly lower on yen's fall.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends slightly lower on yen's fall.

text.p: The won closed slightly weaker against the dollar on Thursday in line with the yen's slide against the U.S. unit, dealers said.
But they said banks unwound dollar positions towards the close on expectations of the yen's rebound.
"The market is now quite closely tied to the yen's movement," said a foreign bank dealer.
The won closed at its opening level of 890.60, compared with Wednesday's closing of 890.40. It moved between 890.40 and 891.80. Dealers said commercial orders were fairly balanced.
The won's mid-rate is expected to be pegged at 890.80/90 on Friday, compared with 890.60 today.
The foreign bank dealer forecast trading would range between 890.00 and 891.50 on Friday.
